_comment: Google Cloud role packs (kobo#390). The inventory pack is every viewer role the permission service's gcp_*_read catalogue rows name in extra.roles: what an agent granted a read permission on a project may be leased. The models pack is what lets the project's Vertex AI models serve the room. Granted to the permission service's identity on a project, folder or organization; no key is made anywhere.

packs.purpose: See what exists: resources, configuration and settings across services. Never the data a service holds.
Use the project's Vertex AI models as the room's models, so agents think with them.
